title: Tungsten Dagger
html:
Crafted (Weapon Smithing Lv 61)

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Dagger weapon skill. Archers start with it. Everyone else can finish the quest The Mercy Knives (Warden Maud Ferrow, level 11): free, and you keep the skill for good, or study a Dagger tome (1 skill point; vendors no longer sell them, so look on the Exchange).

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Crafted with Weapon Smithing at level 61 (7910 XP) from 3× Tungsten Bar.

No monster drops recorded for this item.

Guides: Weapon smithing
